title: Login Streaks of 3+ Consecutive Days
dataset_names: Month boundaries, leap day, repeated streaks
hints: Deduplicate to one row per (user_id, login_date) first; several logins on the same day must not break or inflate a streak.
Gaps-and-islands trick: login_date minus ROW_NUMBER() (per user, ordered by date) is constant within a run of consecutive days.
Group by user and that constant, take MIN/MAX/COUNT, keep groups with COUNT >= 3.
